title: Scaled Cook Card
user: A home cook scaling a familiar recipe who needs every preparation step to retain the correctly scaled ingredient quantities while cooking hands-free.
smallest_useful_product: Static/offline web app that imports a small YAML/JSON recipe, scales servings, renders bound ingredient tokens in each step, and saves actual yield/substitutions locally.
success_measure: In a pilot of 20 cooked recipes, users report zero manual quantity recalculations and save corrections on at least 30% of recipes.
constraints: Use user-authored/imported recipes only; no copyrighted site extraction; large touch controls and screen-wake behavior must degrade safely when unsupported.
why_distinct: It treats a recipe as a live, scaled procedure rather than a collection to browse.
